retention_schedule.name: activity_log
retention_schedule.reason: Append-only and hash-chained (ADR-0005): deleting rows would break verify-log. The WORM archive keeps the log under COMPLIANCE retention (KEEL_ARCHIVE_RETENTION_DAYS, default 7 years) and Keel never deletes from it.

retention_schedule.name: evidence_exports
retention_schedule.reason: Built on demand and downloaded; Keel stores no copy, only the export Activity.

retention_schedule.name: findings
retention_schedule.reason: Resolved Findings stay three years, a full audit cycle. Open Findings, and Findings a Recommendation, Exception or break-glass use names, are never deleted.

retention_schedule.name: cost_facts
retention_schedule.reason: Billing lines stay five years, as accounting records.

retention_schedule.name: tenant_reports
retention_schedule.reason: Monthly reports carry cost figures; kept as long as the billing lines.

retention_schedule.name: utilisation
retention_schedule.reason: Rightsizing reads recent weeks; a year and a month allows year-on-year comparison.

retention_schedule.name: webhook_deliveries
retention_schedule.reason: Delivery ids only guard against replays of recent deliveries.

retention_schedule.name: sessions
retention_schedule.reason: Sessions name the signed-in person; kept 30 days past expiry for incident review.
